finding.statement: For (g,n)=(6,6) the C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE obligation is dischargeable using only (i) the universal property of M_{6,6} applied to the ordered reduced-support CE model over a smooth scheme atlas of H^bal, and (ii) the open-closed localization of the smooth stack M_{6,6} along the reduced Zariski closure Y of the resulting classifying image: setting T_Z := ker(T -> W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6} minus Y;Q)(21)) realises FND-0168(3a)'s image of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q) -> T, by exactness of W_{-16} on the Borel-Moore localization sequence together with compatibility of Poincare duality with open restriction on the smooth pair. No closed embedding of Z, regular immersion, lci hypothesis, codimension-four purity, or Gysin degree shift is required at any point. Consequently FND-0052 and FND-0168(5a)/(5b) are not obstructions to the interface subproblem; they become binding only where T_Z must be computed or shown Tate.
